test_empty_frame_dtypes: test DataFrame.dtypes returns correct dtype for empty frames, no-column frames, and no-row frames
test_datetime_with_tz_dtypes: test DataFrame.dtypes correctly reports DatetimeTZDtype for columns with timezone-aware datetime data
test_dtypes_are_correct_after_column_sli: test DataFrame.dtypes remain unchanged after slicing columns with iloc
test_dtypes_are_correct_after_groupby_la: test DataFrame.dtypes preserve BooleanDtype after groupby().last() on nullable data
test_dtypes_timedeltas: test DataFrame.dtypes correctly report datetime64[ns] and timedelta64[us] for datetime and timedelta columns
